newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek cash rates in range box, ecu/drs stable.
newsitem.headline: Greek cash rates in range box, ecu/drs stable.

text.p: Greek depos and implied forward drachma rates from forex swaps were hovering around late Friday levels on ample liquidity and ecu/drachma was consolidating with an upward bias in thin dealing with U.S markets closed today for Presidents' Day.

"There is little movement in depos and implieds," said dealers at a foreign bank. "The central bank's 50 basis point cut in overnight funds had been discounted to a large extent and affected just short periods up to one-month."
The central bank slashed its overnight bid by 50 basis points to 11.90 percent on Friday.

There is so much liquidity around from rolling forex positions, sales of stripped bonds and other securities that short-term depo rates would have collapsed if it were not for the central bank's intervention, said a dealer at a private bank.
Forex forwards did not react to the intervention rate cut and remained steady, dealers said.
Bond dealers said there was scant activity with tax plays between taxable and tax-free bonds dominating.

"Coupon bonds and FRNs have had their rally on expectations of lower inflation, intervention rate and FRN spread cuts," said a bond dealer. "The FRN dicount margin is currently 75 to 80 basis points over the 12-month T-bill when the FRN spread had been fixed at 140 basis points over the reference rate in late January."
The carry remains negative for coupon bonds but positive for FRNs provided that the investors are foreigners and will get a tax refund.
The mark was quoted at 156.30/35 drachmas from Friday's 156.440 fix, the dollar at 264.62/72 drachmas from 263.730 and the Ecu at 303.92/02 from 303.890 drachmas.
"It is very quiet so far with New York closed," said a forex dealer. "Ecu/drachma is trading between 303.95/00."
